title: OpenCode 2 (default)
description: OpenCode 2 on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its maker's models (opencode.ai) are reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: OpenCode 2 (Standard)
de.description: OpenCode 2 an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur die Modelle seines Herstellers (opencode.ai) sind erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: OpenCode Zen on opencode.ai (its free models need no account; /connect in OpenCode 2 signs in, kept in the start's HOME). Another provider: --api-key api.anthropic.com=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or api.openai.com=OPENAI_API_KEY, openrouter.ai=OPENROUTER_API_KEY) with --model PROVIDER/MODEL, or a model server of yours with --llm (the preset opencode2-local-llm).
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-opencode2 or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on; its update check, model catalog download and shared background service are off.
Its image first: sandbox-ai build opencode2 (a start builds it when it is missing). sandbox-ai opencode stays OpenCode 1.
